summary: Legacy supplier credit-term repricing affects early-payment discount calculation and auto-settlement
description: Issue summary: After a retroactive repricing of credit terms for Vendor: NorthPoint Logistics (legacy supplier record), several invoices that had been auto-marked for early-payment discounts and subsequently auto-settled were reprocessed in the vendor portal, causing discrepancies between Redwood's GL (AP clearing) and the vendor statement. Impact: Cash application and month-end AP balance mismatch for NorthPoint (approx. $18,420 total), potential duplicate early-pay discounts applied, and one payment moved to suspense. This affects the AP ledger and could trigger reconciliation variance for the month close. Environment: Production AP system, vendor portal (legacy supplier_id NP-0042), bank queue (ACH-US-East). Steps to reproduce: 1) Locate legacy supplier NP-0042 in vendor portal. 2) Apply historical credit-term change (EOM30 -> PPNET10) flagged as backdated to 2026-02-01. 3) Trigger the batch repricing job that recalculates eligible early-pay discounts. 4) Observe invoices previously settled still show adjusted discount metadata and AP clearing entries remain unchanged. Observed behavior / logs: - Repricing job (ap-reprice-v1) logged backdate flag and executed re-evaluation for 23 invoices (job log id: reprice-20260310-87). - Payment service returned status "applied-suspense" for payment id PAY-98764. - GL entries show AP clearing debit remains at original invoice amount; discount taken appears as a vendor credit memo but not applied to the payment record. - Vendor statement (PDF received 2026-03-09) shows net applied discounts totaling $1,120 which do not match our GL. Business impact: Reconciliation effort required, potential vendor dispute if not corrected before statement cut-off, and finance close delays. Urgency: Moderate; needs fixes and a reconciliation plan before EOD 2026-03-15.
steps_to_reproduce: Open vendor portal and search NP-0042
Run backdated repricing job with historical change flag
Inspect AP clearing and payment records for reprocessed invoices
Compare to vendor statement PDF (vendor portal -> documents)
investigation_notes: Initial triage by AP on 2026-03-10: identified backdated credit-term change as trigger
Repricing job re-evaluates discount eligibility but currently writes discount amounts to vendor-credit memo instead of adjusting payment entries for already-settled payments
Payment service marks one payment PAY-98764 as 'applied-suspense' when encountering a credit memo without matching apply path
GL team: debit/credit mismatch scoped to account 2100-AP-Clearing for NP-0042 only; other suppliers unaffected

Hypothesis: backdate flag path triggers legacy code branch that avoids adjusting settled payments to preserve audit trail; however, the vendor-credit memo generation code did not create an apply instruction for settled payments
